close_reason: Expanded benches/dispatcher.rs doc block with explicit catches-vs-does-not-catch list. Cross-references bd:JMAP-jfia.10 for serialize_value coverage gap. Adding a realistic-shape bench remains opt-in scope.
description:
crate-jmap-server/benches/dispatcher.rs:197-203 — NoopHandler returns json!({}) without touching args or caller. The bench measures pure dispatcher overhead: task::spawn, JoinError handling, push to method_responses, createdIds extraction, ResultReference resolution.

For the stated purpose (regression-detect dispatcher hot-path changes), this is fine. The bench docstring already says "the bench measures the dispatcher overhead, not handler work" (line 192).

Mild improvement opportunity: add ONE bench that includes a realistic-shape handler — e.g., a handler that serializes a `Vec<MockObject>` via serialize_value, matching the actual handle_get pattern. That would surface regressions in the serialize_value path (relevant given JMAP-jfia.10 about handle_get's per-object to_value). But this is opt-in scope; the current 5 benches are well-chosen.

Marking as opinion because adding more benches is preference-driven; the current set is fine.
title: Dispatcher benches use NoopHandler that returns json!({}) — measures spawn overhead but not realistic handler cost
